0022600210.text: The Golden State Warriors (7-3, on a seven-game winning streak and 5-1 at home) host the 4-6 New Orleans Pelicans, who have lost two straight, in the Warriors' 11th game of the season. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee, surgery) and Will Richard (thumb), and Gary Payton II (knee) and Gui Santos (knee, tendinitis) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee bruise). The Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, but the Pelicans beat them 113-109 in New Orleans on February 24, 2026, and the 2026-27 series has no games yet.
